channel.title: Apsis blog
channel.description: Tips, strategy and behind-the-scenes posts about Apsis.

item.title: Apsis beginner tips: seven habits that save hearts
item.description: Seven habits for Apsis: find the free arrows first, read the band and not the line, respect long arrows, and follow straight paths across curved orbits.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Calm by design: no timers, no energy, just the night sky
item.description: Why Apsis has no timers or energy, where its few ads sit, how three hearts keep it gentle, and what the sound, music and vibration settings do.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How Apsis levels are made: built backwards, scored by reads
item.description: Behind the scenes: how Apsis builds every level backwards so it can always be cleared, measures difficulty in reads, and makes sure no level repeats another.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How the hint works in Apsis, and why it is always right
item.description: What Apsis's hint shows, how it picks which arrow to light, why a hinted tap can never miss, and what happens if you ask while an arrow is still flying.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How to play Apsis: the rules in two minutes
item.description: Learn to play Apsis, the arrow puzzle on orbits: tap an arrow and it flies straight out if its path is clear, or bounces back and costs a heart if not.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Made by two: how a person and an AI built Apsis
item.description: Apsis is made by Shravan Goswami and Claude Opus 5.5, an AI model by Anthropic. Who did what, how the work was checked, and what we learned building it.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Straight lines across circles: the geometry inside Apsis
item.description: How Apsis decides exactly what a flying arrow hits, why paths along an orbit catch their neighbours, and how the game works out which arrow your finger meant.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Three stars in Apsis: how hearts and misses are scored
item.description: Why Apsis scores misses instead of moves, how three hearts become your stars, what a miss really costs, and a simple routine for clearing levels without one.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: What is an apsis? The astronomy behind the name
item.description: An apsis is the point in an orbit nearest to or farthest from the body it goes around: periapsis, apoapsis, perihelion and apogee, explained.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5
